IGBOLANG 1: Focus is on speaking, writing, reading, and listening abilities in Igbo. Interactive approach enables students to express concepts and develop communicative competence at the basic level. Cultural context is an essential part of the course.
IGBOLANG 3: Continuation of IGBOLANG 2. Prerequisite: IGBOLANG 2. Fulfills the University Foreign Language requirement.
IGBOLANG 395: Prerequisite: For Grad Students Only and Consent of Instructor
